The '''''Dar'oosh''''' was a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] that was used by a [[Brigade/Legends|brigade]] of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Shock trooper/Legends|shock troopers]] known as the [[Specialist Unit Two Hundred Seven]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. In [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], the mercenaries traveled in the ''Dar'oosh'' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Darkknell/Legends|Darkknell]] and their leader, [[Kr'saang]] the [[Togorian/Legends|Togorian]], met with the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]]. However, Kr'saang angered Daiman, so the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] the Togorian, and ordered some of his [[Corrector]]s to go to the ''Dar'oosh'' and push the other mercenaries into service with the [[Daimanate|Daimanite]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Army/Legends|army]].
